scope: Existing DPERF04 assignment reachability acceptance refinement; no new task, claim, schema or implementation

finding.priority: P2 source UX gap; not runtime overlap evidence
finding.fact: Registered task detail shows claimId/version, lead/worker, state/role, branch/worktree, exact scope, origin/observation/update, stale-still-occupied and next owner. Unregistered claim cards show only taskId, lead/worker, state/branch/worktree; there is no registered taskButton or claim disclosure, so exact occupied scope and claim version cannot be inspected through that UI path. aggregate returns full claim data already.
finding.impact: An active claim whose status source is not registered remains an occupied scope in the authoritative ledger. The dashboard displays its existence but does not expose enough detail for co-leads to identify the exact reservation. This is not proof that a conflict occurred.

existingPlanAcceptance: Under existing DPERF04 app.js scope, provide a bounded keyboard-operable claim disclosure for every unregistered active/handoff claim, without creating a fake registered task or a second handwritten status source.

Reuse the same claim fact renderer for registered/unregistered locations: exact claimId/version, role/state, lead/worker, branch/worktree, scopes, source match/not-applicable, original observedAt/updatedAt, next receiver and stale-still-occupied warning.

Preserve literal user-facing values with textContent. Include long scopes, escaped text, review/integration roles, handoff_pending and stale cases in the already-planned synthetic assignment browser checks; do not add a new test budget.

Latest assignment failure must show unknown and original timestamp if retaining previous claims, never imply empty/unclaimed. Assignment response/current registry fingerprint governs source matching, independently of status summary/detail proof.
Dashboard remains read-only. Only original atomic take/amend/accept/release COMMITTED receipt grants write authority; stale or invisible claims are never automatic release.
